description:
• About our brand and products:

Base Notes is a men’s scent-performance brand built around fragrance layering, cologne longevity, and elevated masculine grooming. Our products are designed to work beneath a man’s fragrance routine, helping create the ideal base layer for stronger scent presence, cleaner projection, and longer-lasting fragrance performance.

Our product line includes men’s fragrance-layering lotions, omega-rich body oils, car air fresheners, and lifestyle products built around modern masculine scent culture. Core products include Base Notes Sandalwood & Spices, Woody Amber & Leather, Base Layer Unscented, Aurelia Prime Layer 6-9, and Base Notes car air fresheners such as Pine, New Ride, and Midnight Ice.

Base Notes is not positioned as ordinary skincare. It is built as a luxury men’s scent-performance system for customers who care about smelling better, presenting themselves well, and making their fragrance last longer.

• What makes us different:

Most lotions and body products compete with cologne. Base Notes is designed to work beneath it.

Our brand focuses specifically on men’s fragrance layering and scent performance, a category that is underdeveloped in the men’s grooming market. Instead of selling basic lotion, we position our products as the foundation of a man’s fragrance routine.

What makes Base Notes different:

✔ Built specifically for men’s fragrance layering
✔ Designed to help support cologne longevity
✔ Masculine luxury branding and scent profiles
✔ Products made to work beneath fragrance, not overpower it
✔ Strong appeal to fragrance collectors, grooming customers, gym culture, and luxury lifestyle audiences
✔ Highly marketable product concept for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and affiliate content
✔ Clear problem-solution messaging: most men wear cologne, but few know how to make it last longer

Base Notes gives affiliates a strong content angle because the product is easy to demonstrate, explain, and position through fragrance routines, grooming videos, and “smell expensive” content.

• How affiliates can earn:

Affiliates can earn by promoting Base Notes products through custom affiliate links, discount codes, product recommendations, social media content, reviews, tutorials, and fragrance-layering demonstrations.

Affiliates can create content around men’s grooming, cologne layering, fragrance longevity, date-night routines, gym routines, car scent products, and luxury lifestyle upgrades. When customers purchase through the affiliate’s link or code, the affiliate earns commission on eligible sales.

Best affiliate opportunities include:

✔ Promoting individual products
✔ Promoting product bundles
✔ Creating “best lotion for cologne” content
✔ Creating “how to make cologne last longer” content
✔ Reviewing Base Notes products
✔ Demonstrating before-and-after fragrance routines
✔ Recommending scent pairings for popular colognes
✔ Promoting seasonal scent routines and gift sets

Base Notes products are highly suited for repeat promotion because customers can buy multiple scents, bundle products, reorder body care, and purchase car air fresheners.

• How to promote us:

Affiliates should promote Base Notes as a men’s fragrance-performance brand, not just a lotion company.

Strong promotion angles include:

✔ “The men’s lotion built for cologne layering”
✔ “Make your fragrance last longer”
✔ “Most lotions clash with cologne — Base Notes works beneath it”
✔ “Smell expensive longer”
✔ “The missing layer in your fragrance routine”
✔ “Best base layer before applying cologne”
✔ “Upgrade your grooming routine”
✔ “Luxury scent performance for men”

Recommended content formats:

  1. TikTok and Instagram Reels
    Short videos showing how to apply Base Notes before cologne, scent pairing recommendations, grooming routines, and luxury product shots.

  2. YouTube Shorts
    Quick educational videos such as “How to make cologne last longer” or “Best lotion for fragrance layering.”

  3. Product reviews
    Honest reviews explaining scent, feel, application, and how the product fits into a fragrance routine.

  4. Routine content
    Morning routine, date-night routine, gym routine, shower routine, car routine, and luxury grooming setup.

  5. Fragrance pairing content
    Recommend Base Notes products with popular colognes such as Dior Sauvage, Bleu de Chanel, Creed Aventus, Afnan Supremacy, YSL Y, JPG Le Male, and Tom Ford Oud Wood.

  6. Lifestyle content
    Use visuals involving watches, cars, gym bags, cologne collections, bathroom counters, night-out preparation, and premium masculine aesthetics.

Suggested hashtags:

#BaseNotes #FragranceTok #CologneTok #MensGrooming #MensFragrance #FragranceLayering #CologneLayering #SmellExpensive #ScentPerformance #LuxuryGrooming #MensStyle #TikTokMadeMeBuyIt

• Other information:

Base Notes is built for men who care about scent, confidence, grooming, and presentation. Our brand works best with creators who understand fragrance culture, men’s grooming, lifestyle content, self-improvement, gym culture, fashion, cars, or luxury aesthetics.

Affiliates should keep content authentic, clean, masculine, and visually premium. The best-performing content should feel natural and creator-led, not overly polished or scripted.

Brand tone:

✔ Masculine
✔ Premium
✔ Confident
✔ Modern
✔ Fragrance-focused
✔ Educational but simple
✔ Luxury without being complicated

Avoid positioning Base Notes as a medical product or making guaranteed performance claims. Use language such as “helps support fragrance longevity,” “designed for scent layering,” “built beneath your fragrance,” and “helps create a better base for cologne application.”

Base Notes is ideal for creators who want to promote a unique men’s grooming concept with strong viral potential and clear customer value.
